entities.name: Ekkehard of Aura
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ekkehard of Aura was the first abbot of Aura from 1108. The monastery was founded by Bishop Otto of Bamberg on the Franconian Saale river, near Bad Kissingen, Bavaria. It is thought that Ekkehard was a member of the Bavarian aristocracy.
